test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 02 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All chalan are tax.

All chalan are rebate.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some tax are rebate.

(II): All rebate are chalan.
solution:
Statements:

All chalan are tax.

All chalan are rebate.

So, Chalan ⊆ Tax and Chalan ⊆ Rebate

Conclusion I: Some tax are rebate

Since all chalan are both tax and rebate, some tax must be rebate. ✔️ Follows

Conclusion II: All rebate are chalan

This cannot be concluded because rebate may contain elements other than chalan. ❌ Does not follow

**Hence, only conclusion I follows.**
